q: 18 men can pave a 12m road in 20 days. How much road can 12 men pave in 15 days?
If 100 cats kill 100 mice in 100 days, in how many days will 4 cats kill 4 mice?
sol: Rate is 1 cat kills 1 mouse per 100 days regardless of scale → still 100 days

q: 36 men build a 140m wall in 21 days. How many men are needed to build it in 14 days at the same rate?
40 girls make 640 garlands in 8 hours. How many girls are needed to make 720 garlands in 1 hour?
sol: 320 girl-hours make 640 garlands → 0.5 girl-hr/garland. 720 garlands in 1hr needs 360 girls

q: 5 persons make 5 mats in 5 hours. How many mats will 10 persons make in 10 hours?
sol: 1 person makes 1 mat in 5 hours → rate=1/5 mat/hr. 10×10×(1/5)=20 mats

q: Some people complete a work in 12 days. In how many days will double the people complete half the work?
Some persons complete a work in 84 days. In how many days will double the persons complete half the work?
50 people complete a work in 12 days working 6 hrs/day. Same work is done by 60 people in 8 days working x hrs/day. Find x.
Sitaram can paint 8/9 of a painting in 848 days. How long for the complete painting?
A canteen needs 56kg rice for 7 days. Find total kg needed for April and May combined (61 days).
Some persons complete work in 84 days. Double the persons complete half the work in how many days?
31 boys earn ₹1240 in 4 days. How much will 32 boys earn in 8 days?
30 people working 6 hrs/day for 24 days produce 1500 units. In how many days will 18 men working 8 hrs/day produce 1800 units?
sol: 30×24×6=4320 man-hrs for 1500 units. 18×8×d = required man-hrs for 1800 units → d=36

q: 20 persons working 8 hrs/day complete a work in 21 days. How many hours/day should 48 persons work to finish in 7 days?
A pit 100m×50m×10m takes 10 days to dig. How many meters long can a 25m-wide, 15m-deep pit be dug in 30 days at the same rate?
sol: Rate=5000 m³/day. In 30 days: 150000 m³. Length=150000/(25×15)=400m

q: A group of men was assigned work for 60 days. 18 men didn't show up, and the rest finished in 96 days. Find the original number of men.
Some people can finish a work in 50 days. With 4 fewer people, it takes 20 more days. Find the original number of people.
Some persons complete work in 160 days. With 18 more persons, it takes 20 fewer days. Find the original number.
Some persons complete work in 60 days. With 6 more, it finishes 20 days early. Find the original number.
A work is completed in 96 days by some workers. Due to 16 workers' absence, it takes 108 days. Find the actual number of workers.
20 women complete work in 16 days. 16 men complete it in 15 days. Find the ratio of 1 man's to 1 woman's efficiency.
Food for 2400 soldiers lasts 60 days at 750g/soldier/day. After 43 days, 900 soldiers leave. How many more days will the food last at 850g/soldier/day for the rest?
Ration for 660 rebels at 800g/soldier/day lasts 45 days. After 10 days, more insurgents arrive; at 1400g/day the remaining ration lasts only 15 more days. Find the number of new insurgents.
18 men or 36 boys plow a field in 24 days at 6hr/day. How many days will 24 men+24 boys take working 9hr/day?
A person plans 150 days for a job with 200 people, but only 1/4 is done in 50 days. How many additional people are needed to finish on time?
20 persons complete work in 120 days. After 60 days, 10 more (same efficiency) join. Find the total days to finish.
A hostel has food for 200 students for 50 days. After 10 days, 50 more students join. How long will the food last now?
A painter agrees to paint 4128 sqm with 12 men in 24 days. After 14 days only 1032 sqm is done. How many more workers are needed if they now work 7/5× the hours?
6 women complete work in 10 days. 10 children alone complete it in 15 days. How many days for 6 women+10 children together?
Work is completed by: 4 girls in 8 days, 3 boys in 9 days, 7 men in 2 days, 5 women in 4 days. Which group has the minimum per-person work capacity?
sol: Per-person rates: girls 1/32, boys 1/27, women 1/20, men 1/14 → girls are slowest

q: 10 men+15 women together complete work in 6 days. The same work is done by 1 man alone in 100 days. Find the days for 1 woman alone.
12 men+16 boys complete work in 5 days; 13 men+24 boys complete it in 4 days. Find the ratio of 1 man's to 1 boy's daily work.
5 men+7 women complete a field in 10 days; 20 men+42 women complete it in 2 days. Find the days for 10 men+15 women.
27 men or 45 women complete a work in 52 days. How many days for 16 men+21 women to complete 1/3 of the work?
sol: M:W=5:3. TW in women-units=45×52×... solving for 1/3 work → 16 4/11 days

q: 12 men complete a work in 18 days; 12 women complete it in 24 days. Find the days for 10 men+8 women.
6 girls+8 boys complete work in 8 hours; 4 boys+5 girls complete it in 12 hours. If each girl's capacity drops 20%, how long will 12 girls alone take?
sol: B:G=3:4. TW=384. 12 girls at 80% efficiency → 384/38.4=10 hr

q: 12 men+18 boys working 7.5hr/day complete work in 60 days (2 men=3 boys efficiency). How many boys are needed among 22 people to finish double the work in 50 days at 9hr/day?
sol: M:B=3:2. TW(boy-units)=72×60×7.5. Solve (22-x men equiv+xB)×9×50=2×TW → x=39 boys

q: 9 children do a work in 360 days, 18 men in 72 days, 12 women in 162 days. Find the days for 4 men+12 women+10 children together.
A,B together complete work in 40 days. They start; after 8 days C joins, and the work finishes 24 days after C joins. Find C's alone time.
sol: (A+B):(A+B+C)=3:4 → C's share of rate ×TW → C alone=120 days

q: A,B together complete a work in 36 minutes. If B stops after 32 minutes, the tank fills in 42 minutes total. Find B's alone time.
A,B together complete work in 18 hours. After 6 hours A leaves; B alone finishes the rest in 36 hours. Find A's alone time.
A,B together complete work in 20 days. If A works at half efficiency and B at 6× efficiency, they take 220/6 (36⅔) days. Find A's alone time. (approximate)
sol: A:B=6:5. TW≈220. A alone≈36⅔ days, closest to 36

q: 20 men work for 5 days on a task planned for 300 man-days total. In how many more days will the remaining work be completed (at the original 25-man rate)?
55 men complete a work in 40 days; 132 women complete it in 30 days. 30 men work 20 days, then leave, and 15 women join to finish. Find the remaining days needed.
sol: M:W=9:5. TW=19800. Solve remaining days after 30men×20days → 48 days

q: 4 men+9 women complete work in 9 days; 6 men+6 women complete it in 7 days. Find the days for 7 men+4 women.
40 men working 8hr/day complete work in 15 days. 60 men working 4hr/day do double the work; given group-1 efficiency:group-2 = 2:1. Find days.
sol: Efficiency ratio 2:1. TW converted to group-2 units, doubled. Solve → 80 days

q: 16 persons working 6hr/day complete work in 10 days. How many days for 24 persons working 8hr/day to do 80% of the work?
1 man completes work in 10 days, 1 woman in 20 days. Men work at 60% efficiency, women at 50%. Find the days for them together.
20 men+32 women working 5hr/day for 7 days cut 7/11 of 1254 hectares. With 5 more men+8 more women at 4hr/day (1 man=1.25× woman), find days for the rest.
sol: Solve rate equations → 4 days for remaining work

q: A,B together complete work in 8 days. If A works at double efficiency and B at 60% efficiency, it finishes in 6 days. Find B's alone time.
3 men+4 women+6 boys complete work in 5 days (woman=2×man's rate, boy=half man's rate). How many women alone complete it in 7 days?
A work can be completed by 28 women in 36 days. After 18 days, 4 women leave. Find the days needed to complete the remaining work.
sol: After 18 days, 504 woman-days done, 504 remaining. 24 women left → 504/24=21 days

q: 4 men+5 children+8 women complete work in 25 days; 4 children+6 women complete it in 50 days; 6 men+9 women complete it in 40 days. Find the days for 60 women alone.
sol: Solve the 3 simultaneous rate equations → 60 women alone = 55 days

q: A group of men is building a wall. After half is built, the group doubles. The wall finishes 6 days early. Find the originally scheduled total days.
5 men do a work in 12 days; 10 women do it in 15 days. Together with 15 children they finish in 5 days for ₹36000 total pay. Find the 5 children's share.
sol: M:W=5:2. TW=300. Men+women's 5-day share=225 of 300; children's share of pay = ₹3000

q: 3 men+4 women+6 boys complete work in 6 days (woman=3×man, boy=half×man). How many women alone complete it in 4 days?
sol: Efficiency M:W:B=2:6:1. TW=216. 4 days × N women × 6 = 216 → N=9

q: 10 pipes fill a tank in 28 minutes. If 3 pipes fail, how long will the remaining pipes take?
1 man, or 2 women (combined), or 3 boys (combined) can each complete a work in 55 days. Find the days for 1 man+1 woman+1 boy together.
sol: Efficiency M:W:B=6:3:2. TW=330. Combined=11 units → 330/11=30 days

q: 9 men or 16 boys complete a work in 20 days. Find the days for 10 men+8 boys together.
An army has ration for 50 soldiers for 50 days. If there are 80 soldiers and they reduce consumption by 20%, estimate how many days the ration lasts.
12 men do a work in 10 days; 9 women do it in 20 days. 3 men work T days, then 3 women join, finishing the rest in 6 more days. Find T.
10 men+15 women complete work in 50/7 days; 25 men+5 women complete it in 7.5 days. Find the days for 20 men+12 women.
P,Q together complete work in 16 days. If P works 4.5 days and Q works 11.5 days, 62.5% remains pending. Find the time for Q alone to complete 50% of the work.
A complex combined-rate problem: 22 men+18 women+14 children finish work in 36 days given stated ratios. Find the days for 10 women alone.
sol: Solve the multi-group system → TW=2160. 10 women alone = 216 days

q: 4000 soldiers have ration for 40 days (1250g/day each). After 22 days, 1600 leave and some new soldiers join (1000g/day each). Ration now lasts 37 more days. Find the number of new soldiers.
